title: Diploma in Computer Engineering - First Year Syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: What is the first year syllabus for Diploma in Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The first year includes English-I, Engineering Mathematics-I, Engineering Physics, Engineering Chemistry and Environmental Studies, Basics of Computer Engineering, Programming in C, Engineering Drawing, Programming in C Lab, Physics Lab, Chemistry Lab and Computer Fundamentals Lab.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the first year subjects in Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The first year subjects are English-I, Engineering Mathematics-I, Engineering Physics, Engineering Chemistry and Environmental Studies, Basics of Computer Engineering, Programming in C, Engineering Drawing, Programming in C Lab, Physics Lab, Chemistry Lab and Computer Fundamentals Lab.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in English-I?
possible_questions_answers.answer: English for Employability, Living in Harmony, Connect with Care, Humour for Happiness, Never Ever Give Up!, Preserve or Perish, The Rainbow of Diversity, New Challenges- Newer Ideas, The End Point First, The Equal Halves and Dealing with Disaster.

units: Algebra: Functions, Partial Fractions, Matrices and Determinants

Trigonometry: Trigonometric Ratios, Compound Angles, Multiple and Submultiple Angles, Transformations, Inverse Trigonometric Functions, Trigonometric Equations, Properties of Triangles, Complex Numbers
Co-ordinate Geometry: Straight Lines, Circles, Conic Sections
Differential Calculus: Limits and Continuity, Differentiation
Applications of Derivatives: Geometrical Applications, Physical Applications, Maxima and Minima, Errors and Approximations

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Engineering Mathematics-I?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Algebra, Trigonometry, Co-ordinate Geometry, Differential Calculus and Applications of Derivatives.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Engineering Physics?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Units and Measurements, Statics, Gravitation, Concepts of Energy, Thermal Physics, Sound, Electricity and Magnetism, and Modern Physics.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Engineering Chemistry and Environmental Studies?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Fundamentals of Chemistry, Solutions, Acids and Bases, Electrochemistry, Corrosion, Water Treatment, Polymers and Engineering Materials, Fuels, and Environmental Studies.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is CM-105?
possible_questions_answers.answer: CM-105 is Basics of Computer Engineering in the first year Diploma in Computer Engineering curriculum.

units: Input and Output Statements, Operators and Expressions in C
Decision Making, Iterative and Other Control Statements
Arrays and Strings, Structures and Unions
User Defined Functions, Pointers, File Management and Preprocessor Directives

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Programming in C?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Introduction to C Language; Input and Output, Operators and Expressions; Decision Making and Iterative Control Statements; Arrays, Strings, Structures and Unions; and User Defined Functions, Pointers, File Management and Preprocessor Directives.

units: Use of Drawing Instruments, Free Hand Lettering and Dimensioning Practice
Projections of Points, Lines, Planes and Solids

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Engineering Drawing?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers drawing instruments and dimensioning, geometric constructions, projections, sectional views and orthographic projection.

units: C programming practical exercises based on the Programming in C theory syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: Is there a Programming in C practical lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-108 is Programming in C Lab.

units: Physics practical exercises prescribed in the C-23 curriculum

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Physics Lab included in first year?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-109 is Physics Lab.

units: Chemistry practical exercises prescribed in the C-23 curriculum

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Chemistry Lab included in first year?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-110 is Chemistry Lab.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Computer Fundamentals Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab covers Computer Hardware Basics, Windows Operating System, MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and Adobe Photoshop.

title: Diploma in Computer Engineering - III Semester Syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: What subjects are in III semester Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: III semester includes Mathematics-II, Digital Electronics, Operating Systems, Data Structures through C, DBMS, Digital Electronics Lab, Data Structures Through C Lab, DBMS Lab and Multimedia Lab.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Engineering Mathematics-II?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Integral Calculus, Differential Equations, Graph Theory and Probability, and Statistics.

units: Logic Gates, Boolean Algebra and Basic Combinational Circuits

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Digital Electronics?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Number Systems; Logic Gates, Boolean Algebra and Basic Combinational Circuits; Flip-Flops; Counters and Registers; and Additional Combinational Circuits.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Operating Systems?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Introduction to Operating Systems, Process Management, Synchronization and Deadlocks, Memory Management, and Disk Scheduling and File Management.

units: Introduction to Data Structures and Sequential Storage Representation

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Data Structures Through C?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units cover data structures and sequential storage, linked lists, stacks, queues and trees.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in DBMS?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Concepts of DBMS and RDBMS, Concepts of SQL, Basics of PL/SQL, Advance PL/SQL, and Concepts of NoSQL and MongoDB.

units: Digital IC identification, logic gates, adders, comparators, flip-flops, ripple and synchronous counters, shift registers, multiplexers, demultiplexers, encoders and decoders

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Digital Electronics Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The practical work includes digital IC identification, logic gates, adders, comparators, flip-flops, counters, shift registers, multiplexers, demultiplexers, encoders and decoders.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Data Structures Through C Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab includes practical programs for sorting and searching, linked lists, stacks, queues and binary search trees.

possible_questions_answers.question: Is DBMS Lab included in III semester?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-308 is DBMS Lab.

units: Multimedia practical exercises including image editing, selections, layers, painting, photo retouching, colour correction, masks, pen tool, special effects, exporting and logo creation

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Multimedia Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab includes practical work in image editing, selections, layers, painting, photo retouching, colour correction, masks, pen tool, special effects, exporting and logo creation.

title: Diploma in Computer Engineering - IV Semester Syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: What subjects are in IV semester Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: IV semester includes Software Engineering, Web Technologies, Computer Organization and Microprocessors, OOP through Java, Computer Networks and Cyber Security, Web Technologies Lab, Java Lab, Communication Skills, and Computer Networking and Cyber Security Lab.

units: Basics of Software Engineering, Designs and Life Cycle Models
Software Testing, Debugging, Reliability, Quality Management and Maintenance

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Software Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units cover software engineering basics and life cycle models, project management, requirements and specifications, design and coding, and testing, debugging, reliability, quality management and maintenance.

units: Principles of Web Designing and HTML Introduction
Various HTML Tags and Usage of Style Sheets
XML and Client-side Scripting using JavaScript
Web Servers and Server-side Scripting using PHP

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Web Technologies?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers web design and HTML, HTML tags and style sheets, XML and JavaScript, jQuery, and web servers with PHP.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is CM-403?
possible_questions_answers.answer: CM-403 is Computer Organization and Microprocessors in IV semester.

units: Object Oriented Programming Concepts and Basics of Java, Overloading

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in OOP through Java?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units cover Java and OOP basics, inheritance and interfaces, I/O streams and collections, exception handling and multithreading, and Applets, AWT and event handling.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Computer Networks and Cyber Security?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Introduction to Networks, Network Addressing and Management, Cyber Security, Encryption Techniques, and System Security.

units: Practical web page development using HTML and CSS
PHP server-side programming and database connectivity

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Web Technologies Lab included in IV semester?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-406 is Web Technologies Lab.

units: Java programming exercises based on OOP, inheritance, packages, collections, exception handling, multithreading and GUI/event handling

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Java Lab included in IV semester?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-407 is Java Lab.

possible_questions_answers.question: What is CM-408?
possible_questions_answers.answer: CM-408 is Communication Skills, a practical subject in IV semester.

subjects.title: Computer Networking and Cyber Security Lab

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Computer Networking and Cyber Security Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab is divided into Computer Hardware, Computer Networking and Cyber Security.

title: Diploma in Computer Engineering - V Semester Syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: What subjects are in V semester Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: V semester includes Industrial Management and Entrepreneurship, Big Data and Cloud Computing, Android Programming, Internet of Things, Python Programming, Android Programming Lab, Python Programming Lab, Life Skills and Project Work.

units: Engineering Ethics, Safety and Labour Codes

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Industrial Management and Entrepreneurship?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units cover Principles of Management, Organization Structure and Organizational Behaviour, Production Management, Engineering Ethics and Safety with Labour Codes, and Entrepreneurship and Start-ups.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Big Data and Cloud Computing?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Overview of Data Mining, Overview of Data Warehousing, Introduction to Big Data, Big Data Analytics, and Cloud Computing.

units: Components, Activity Life Cycle and Intents

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Android Programming?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Android basics and anatomy, application components and activity lifecycle with intents, user interface, advanced Android concepts, and database connectivity.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Internet of Things?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The units are Introduction of IoT, Data Protocols, Communication Technologies, Wireless Sensor Networks, and Role of IoT.

units: Object Oriented Programming in Python, File Handling and Exception Handling

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the units in Python Programming?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The syllabus covers Python programming basics, control flow and loops, functions and arrays, data structures, and OOP with file and exception handling.

units: UI controls such as CheckBox, Spinner, Date Picker, Time Picker and multiple controls
Image effects, Image Switcher and Alert Dialog
Google Maps and Android application exercises

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Android Programming Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab includes Android applications using UI controls, activities, intents, image effects, dialogs, Google Maps, database connectivity and application deployment.

units: File handling, OOP and exception handling programs

possible_questions_answers.question: What is covered in Python Programming Lab?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The lab covers basic Python programs, data types, operators, conditions, loops, functions, data structures, files, OOP and exception handling.

units: Life-skill and professional-development activities prescribed in the C-23 curriculum

possible_questions_answers.question: Is Life Skills included in V semester?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. CM-508 is Life Skills.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the main stages of Project Work?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The project work includes feasibility study, requirement analysis and SRS preparation, design, implementation, testing and verification, and project report preparation and presentation.

title: Diploma in Computer Engineering - VI Semester Syllabus

possible_questions_answers.question: What is the VI semester subject in Computer Engineering?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The VI semester is CM-601 Industrial Training, conducted at industry or through two online certificate courses as specified in the curriculum.

possible_questions_answers.question: How long is the industrial training?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The industrial training is scheduled for 6 months.

possible_questions_answers.question: How many marks are assigned to Industrial Training?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Industrial Training carries 300 marks in the scheme of evaluation.

possible_questions_answers.question: What attendance is required during Industrial Training?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The curriculum specifies a minimum of 90% attendance during Industrial Training.

subjects.title: Industrial Training (At Industry / Online Certificate Courses)

training_outcomes: Apply knowledge and skills already learnt in the institution
Acquire skills of analysis, design and development, testing, verification and validation
Acquire skills of deployment and distribution of the product

possible_questions_answers.question: What is CM-601?
possible_questions_answers.answer: CM-601 is Industrial Training in the VI semester.

possible_questions_answers.question: What are the assessment components of Industrial Training?
possible_questions_answers.answer: The scheme includes two industry assessments, a training report, a demonstration of a listed skill and viva voce, totaling 300 marks.

possible_questions_answers.question: Can Industrial Training be completed through online certificate courses?
possible_questions_answers.answer: Yes. The curriculum provides an online certification option using two online certificate courses from listed platforms.
